source: PC NFH2, the anger gauge's jumps in Badinfos' 100 % run (tools/pcref/amounts.py: the jump per second scaled to the full bar, 92 % of the crop, labelled with the HUD bubble's activity) — a jump that hits the full bar is a lower bound and keeps the mobile value where that is higher; a jump shared by linked coins is split in the mobile proportions; an unmeasured coin keeps the mobile value. E06 Every Shot A Hit: +51 as he leaves the pillows (67 s, the bubble already on the dog), +38 the weights (139), +25 the dynamite (190), +63 the pad with the harpoon at the full bar (236: the mobile pair's 30 + 20 + 15 stays); the chair pays on the full bar. PC data (ship2/tricks.xml, rage per trick in thousandths of the gauge): the PC differs from the mobile on Pillows 30 (fleas); the rest are equal. The gauge jumps read off Badinfos' video (2026-09-08) ran 10-25 %% high and are withdrawn. The gauge is 100 000 rage long — the mobile's AngryMeterMaximum 100: the PC dialog (nfh2 dialogs/*/menuleft_bar.xml) gives the rageometer range 0..100000 and GameLogic.dll flags 100000 (docs/PC_ROUTINES.md); the 80 read off the video was the bar's geometry, as the Season 1 tube's was. Its decay is the mobile's 0.37 %/s: the bar falls 41 -> 11 % over 70 trick-free seconds of E01 (tools/pcref/gauge.py, x0.8 for the crop). The decay is leveldata.xml's time="30" per 1/12 s tick (GameLogic.dll fcn.10044234: rage -= the level record's +0x28, the app's leveldata parser stores `time` there; the HUD clock divides the tick count by 12) — PCRageDecay 30, 0.36 %/s against the mobile's 0.37.
